MIXPANEL_TOKEN.description: Mixpanel says a project token is not a secret value and not a form of authorization, and that the browser library makes it available to anyone visiting the page. The name is convention.

MIXPANEL_API_SECRET.description: Mixpanel says not to put it in source or plain-text configuration, and refuses it over plain HTTP. This authentication is deprecated and retires in March 2027, so new work wants a service account instead. The name is convention.
